model_code <- paste(readLines("/app/hierarchical_model.stan", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
writeLines(model_code, "/tmp/mc_dump.txt")
tryCatch(stan(model_code = model_code, data = data, sample = list(iter = 50), seed = 1),
         error = function(e) writeLines(conditionMessage(e), "/tmp/stan_err.txt"))
' 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "===== MC DUMP ====="; cat /tmp/mc_dump.txt; echo "===== STAN ERR ====="; cat /tmp/stan_err.txt
WAIT 120
